authority: Accepted source-close cleaned_roi is the only downstream numeric primitive. Source-canonical geometry/support/age/FD define fixed choices; raw, CSV, bootstrap arrays and JSON are receipts.

common_rules.failure: failure_report.json lexists before/after validation invalidates success, including broken symlink. Never overwrite sources/code/stale output.
common_rules.regular: All five required files must be ordinary files. No symlinks/FIFOs/devices/traversal. Bounded harmless extra files/fields are allowed.
common_rules.json: UTF8, no duplicate keys or NaN/Infinity; actual finite numbers not Boolean/string, actual non-Boolean integers for counts/ranks; undefined scientific scalar=null.
common_rules.csv: Unique nonempty headers and one row per literal subject_id. Scientific numeric notation allowed; undefined number only blank, not NaN/None/0.
common_rules.ids: Literal original participant and coordinate IDs, no aliases or normalization. Required string axes checked for exact shape/kind before conversion or expansion.
common_rules.permutations: Coherent participant/frame/ROI/metric/association/draw row and keyed metadata/CSV permutations accepted; original documentary column order and source row identity remain exact. Bootstrap child_ids must be the sorted canonical source child order because indices reference this explicitly fixed order.
common_rules.extra: Finite harmless numeric extras/descriptive strings within caps allowed; no prose/version-string scoring fingerprint.
common_rules.partition: Production scores one source-bound artifact validation. Authoring equivalence/mutation tests never become extra acceptance gates.

resource_caps.npz_types: No pickle/object/complex/structured dtype, duplicate ZIP paths or nonfinite numeric arrays. Fixed Unicode/bytes, real numeric and Boolean arrays only. Undefined numeric slots use finite0 sentinel plus false defined flag.

subject_ids.semantics: Exact155 literal IDs; axis for canonical_active

roi_ids.semantics: Exact264 literal Power row IDs; axis for raw/clean/active

frame_subject_ids.semantics: Repeated literal subject for each frame row

frame_indices.semantics: Original zero-based released frame; exactunique complete(subject,frame) key

raw_roi.semantics: Scaled source means, receipt only; source raw tolerance

cleaned_roi.semantics: Accepted sole downstream primitive; pointwise and canonical-active centered relative fidelity

canonical_active.semantics: Exact source prestandardization activity; inactive tinyjitter ignored

bootstrap_child_ids.semantics: Exact sorted122 source child IDs, defining index values below; not a reorderable axis

bootstrap_draw_ids.semantics: Unique full0..999 set; may coherently permute draw rows

bootstrap_indices.semantics: Each row exactseed11 draw of122 indices0..121 into sorted bootstrap_child_ids. Columns are ordered RNG draw slots, not subject labels.

bootstrap_r.semantics: Own replay correlation if defined, otherwise exact0 sentinel; never downstream authority

signal_evidence.npz.keying: Normalize required axes to canonical source geometry/frame and fixed RNG order before comparison. Raw and derived receipts do not replace their authorities.
signal_evidence.npz.inactive: Canonicalzero clean, admittedpointwise tinyjitter ignored; no resuscitation of inactiveedges.

connectivity_metrics.csv.source_fields: Age/group from originalphenotype, zero-filledFDsum/T and canonicalactivecount; no FD<5 or cross-person variation gate.
connectivity_metrics.csv.metric_units: Signed Fisher-z means, NOT [-1,1] correlation scale; family bounded byatanh(.999), segregation twice that. Comparison tolerance applies at representable domain boundaries; no abs.
connectivity_metrics.csv.metrics: Own acceptedclean replay within derived tolerance; blank iff corresponding typed status unavailable. Every155 person remains.

child_record.patterns: Own signedr[-1,1]/p[0,1] ornull, exactsupport/status; rawdf120,adjusted122-q-1; completeexpect122. Perfectr±1 retains p0.

age_effects.json.mean_record: {mean:finite Fisher-zunits ornull,n_expected:fixed membership,n_defined:actual defined,status:'ok' or'incomplete_subject_support'}; completeconstantsvalid.
age_effects.json.welch_record: {child:mean_record,adult:mean_record,difference:finite ornull,t:finite ornull,p:[0,1] ornull,df:positivefinite ornull,status:declared reason}. If unavailable all t/p/dfnull; means/difference retained when computable. Complete unrounded accepted segregation and canonical-group variance support.
age_effects.json.restricted_welch_record: welch_record plusfd_thresh exact0.2,child_ids/adult_ids exact canonicalFD<.2 subset keyedmembership. This is restriction, not matching.
age_effects.json.comparison: Own replay numeric tolerance with exact discrete/nullsupport. No canonicalexpected age/r/p/CI/testoutcome target.

source_observed.participants_column_names: Original participant-table column names in original order
source_observed.coordinates: {path,sha256,column_names}: original coordinate source identity and exact ROI,X,Y,Z order
source_observed.persons: Complete keyed list of source_person records
source_observed.frame_alignment: Nonempty description; all released frames retained; no measured movie-onset assertion

source_person.bold_header: All header_fields below, preserving original raw values
source_person.confound_column_names: All original column names in original order
source_person.excluded_confound_columns: Remaining original columns in source order, including FD
source_person.missing_selected_entries: Keyed (frame_index,column_name) list of {frame_index,column_name,original_token,applied_value}; only declared missing tokens, value0
source_person.mean_fd_sum: math.fsum of original finite FD entries
source_person.mean_fd_observed_count: Original finite FD count, including finite initial0
source_person.mean_fd_missing_entries: Keyed missing FD token/location/value records with the same fields as selected missing entries
source_person.mean_fd_zero_filled_sum: Original finite sum plus missing entries filled0
source_person.mean_fd_denominator: Original full frame count, not observed count

run_metadata.json.header_rules: Preserve rawunknownunits/zoom;documentaryTR2 separate. Storage dtype semantic alias permitted onlyexplicitdtypefield. Nonfinite raw documentaryfields use literalNaN,+Inf,-Inf strings, never scientificarrays.

analysis_observed.persons: Complete keyed {subject_id,cleaning_rank,n_active_rois,roi_activity} list. roi_activity contains complete keyed {roi_id,raw_centered_l2,residual_centered_l2,activity_threshold,active} records.
analysis_observed.distance_bins: {q1_mm,q2_mm,n_pairs,n_short_edges,n_long_edges,membership_sha256}; exact membership/counts with header-tolerance distance quantiles. These are source geometry receipts, not hidden endpoints.

run_metadata.json.extra: Descriptions/extra fields harmless; closed literalidentitysets remain exact. Metadata diagnostic numeric tolerance distinct fromscientificreceipt tolerance.

findings.md.requirement: NonemptyUTF8 readable report. Oracle reports its actual child raw/adjusted estimates,bootstrapavailability,group descriptives andrestrictionlimits.
findings.md.grading: No keywords/expecteddirection/conclusion. Numerical authority is structuredsource-bound output.
